description: Implementation of a CookieJar class for managing, serializing, encrypting, compressing, and encoding cookies, including functions for serialization/deserialization, base64 encoding/decoding, compression/decompression, and checksum calculation.

classes.name: CookieJar
classes.description: Manages cookies with serialization, encryption, compression, and encoding functionalities.

methods.name: Pack
methods.description: Serializes and encrypts cookies into a payload with version and checksum.

methods.name: Unpack
methods.description: Decrypts and deserializes cookies from a payload, verifying checksum.

methods.name: GetCookies
methods.description: Returns the current list of cookies.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a vector of cookies into a newline-separated string.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Parses a newline-separated string into a vector of cookies.

methods.name: toBase64
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a base64 string.

methods.name: fromBase64
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into binary data.

methods.name: uncompress
methods.description: Decompresses zlib compressed data into a string.

methods.name: crc_checksum
methods.description: Calculates CRC-16 checksum for a string.
